handoff: Grade 8 Social Studies to Grade 9 United States History and Geography

downstream_first_unit.title: Foundations of High School United States History and Geography

articulation_rule: Michigan places USHG expectation 6.1 at the boundary between Grade 8 and high school: the source document marks 6.1 as introduced in Grade 8 and as the point where high school USHG begins. Grade 8 Unit 9 introduces 1870-1898; Grade 9 Unit 1 establishes high school disciplinary foundations (USHG F1) and Grade 9 Unit 2 resumes content at USHG 6.1.1-6.1.4.
no_gap_check: No USHG era between the Grade 8 endpoint and the Grade 9 starting point is left unaddressed.
no_duplicate_check: Grade 9 does not re-teach Grade 8 Eras 3-5 as content. USHG F1 in Grade 9 Unit 1 is the foundations review the source document specifies for high school, framed as disciplinary practice rather than a repeat survey.
